workflowPhases.description: Resolve the Autopilot serial, remove any associated managed-device record when required, apply the Group Tag, resolve the Entra device, and add it to the pre-provisioning group.
The technician completes network connection, imaging, OOBE, pre-provisioning, deployment-profile validation, reseal, and boot-to-sign-in actions on the physical device.

Only used after an Autopilot failure. The CLI submits allowNextEnrollment or guides review of an interrupted request, then checks managed-device absence; the technician confirms Allowed in Intune and physical reset/reimage before preparation restarts.

Resolve and explicitly confirm the regular active C/E technician account from the Windows login or a supplied username, capture the Intune device name, and remove pre-provisioning membership. Never reuse the privileged Graph identity as the assignment target.

Complete first sign-in, verify the checklist application baseline, request managed-device sync and confirm application retry outcomes, install required updates and follow other procedures, then power off the device. Sync is not the named portal application-remediation action.

The technician explicitly selects an eligible active C/E account, then assigns and verifies final primary ownership. No manager chain, account role or device-classification inference selects the owner.

details: Read the current Autopilot, managed-device and Entra identities for the entered serial. Failed or incomplete discovery is not evidence that a device is absent.
This read does not enrol, delete or reset a device. Review the identity before any later mutation.
steps.summary: Load the current Autopilot, Intune, and Entra context for this serial.
steps.notes: If the serial is not present in Autopilot yet, hand off to the external upload guide and record that outcome.

details: After confirmation, delete only the resolved Intune managed-device record and observe its absence. This does not delete the Autopilot registration or Entra object.
An accepted deletion awaiting observation remains Submitted; a later check must not blindly submit it again.
steps.summary: Remove any existing Intune managed-device record before pre-provisioning begins.
steps.notes: If no associated managed device exists, the step records that no cleanup was required.

details: Derive the Group Tag from the selected site and device type, submit it to the resolved Autopilot identity, then read it back.
A successful request alone is not verification. If the new tag is not yet visible, retain Submitted and check again later.
steps.summary: Set the enforced SITECODE-DeviceType Group Tag on the Autopilot identity.
steps.notes: The script always derives the Group Tag from the selected site and device type.

details: Resolve the exact configured group, inspect other memberships matching its configured prefix, and preview any permitted correction. Conflict removal defaults to No and removes membership references, never groups.
Dynamic, mail-enabled or role-assignable groups are not automatically corrected. Verify the intended membership before proceeding.
steps.summary: Add the Entra device object to the configured Intune pre-provisioning group.
steps.notes: Group membership is part of the formal manifest because it must happen at the correct point in the Autopilot flow. A required write is blocked unless the target is an assigned, non-mail-enabled security group that is not role-assignable; an already-correct read-back state requires no write.

details: On the physical computer, connect the required network, complete imaging and OOBE preparation, and reach the Autopilot deployment-profile screen.
Record only what you have observed. The script does not perform imaging or prove a physical result through Graph.
steps.displayName: Confirm network, imaging and OOBE preparation
steps.summary: Follow checklist steps 6-10 to reach the Autopilot deployment-profile screen.
steps.notes: Confirmation defaults to Y by operator decision. Records technician evidence, not Graph verification.

details: Compare the deployment profile shown on the computer with the configured required profile before continuing pre-provisioning.
This is technician confirmation, not a claim that a successful Graph request proves profile assignment.
steps.summary: Confirm that the required Autopilot deployment profile is assigned.
steps.notes: This release records technician confirmation so the workflow stays honest even where tenant-specific profile fields vary.

details: Use only within an explicitly entered recovery workflow after a failed build. Submit allowNextEnrollment for the resolved Autopilot identity.
Submission is not proof that Intune shows Allowed. Do not use this action as a normal build step or as an automatic retry.
If an earlier request outcome is unknown, check the device in Intune. Confirming Allowed defaults to No; no request is resent.
steps.summary: Submit allowNextEnrollment once for the current recovery, or review an interrupted request without resending.
steps.notes: An accepted request records Submitted, not verified Allowed. An uncertain request is not resent: confirming Allowed records a technician observation and starts a fresh two-minute wait, without claiming HTTP acceptance.

details: Wait two minutes from the current recovery's accepted response, or from the technician's Allowed observation when the earlier request outcome is unknown.
Verify managed-device absence and confirm Allowed in Intune plus the physical reset or reimage.
Close recovery only after these checks. Retain the failed cycle as evidence before preparation starts again.
steps.displayName: Confirm recovery reset, reimage and Allowed status
steps.summary: Follow checklist step 12: wait from the accepted response or Allowed observation, confirm deletion and Allowed, then confirm reset/reimage.
steps.notes: Requires current-cycle P evidence. Allowed is technician evidence, not Graph verification. Default Y. Archives prior results and restarts from B.

details: Observe successful pre-provisioning on the physical computer, then perform and confirm reseal as required by the checklist.
Do not confirm an intended future action or treat a failed pre-provisioning result as a completed reseal.
steps.summary: Follow checklist step 13: complete setup, reseal and wait for shutdown.
steps.notes: On failure, leave this step incomplete and use recovery option X. Confirmation defaults to Y.

details: Boot the resealed computer and observe that it reaches the required Windows sign-in screen.
The confirmation records the technician's observation; it does not sign in or establish a primary-user relationship.
steps.summary: Follow checklist step 14: power up and leave the device at the Windows sign-in screen.
steps.notes: Do not perform the first sign-in before technician assignment and pre-provisioning group removal. Confirmation defaults to Y.

details: Resolve and explicitly confirm the active regular C/E technician account. Use the Windows directory username when available, not the privileged Graph sign-in identity.
Assign the intended user and observe the Autopilot and managed-device relationships. Retain pending or technician-confirmed evidence distinctly from Graph verification.
steps.summary: Resolve the Windows login's regular technician account and require explicit default-No confirmation before assignment on the available Autopilot and managed-device surfaces.
steps.notes: The target must be a resolved eligible active C/E account, not the privileged Graph account. CA plus letters removes CA; CA plus digits replaces CA with e. Uncertain names prompt. Declining confirmation returns to username entry. Unresolved prior assignment targets cannot silently change. Managed-device reference-write support remains a tenant acceptance gate; submission alone is not verification.

details: Remove the device's membership reference from the exact configured pre-provisioning group at the required post-provisioning point.
Read back the resulting membership state. This action does not delete the group or undo unrelated directory memberships.
steps.summary: Remove the device from the configured pre-provisioning group at the correct workflow point.
steps.notes: This mirrors the PDF workflow and must remain explicit in the manifest. A required write uses only the membership reference and is blocked for unsupported group types; an already-absent verified state requires no write.

details: Complete the required first Windows sign-in on the physical computer and confirm the observed result.
This action does not capture a password or infer that applications and updates have completed.
steps.summary: Follow checklist step 17: sign in after technician assignment and pre-provisioning group removal.
steps.notes: Confirmation defaults to Y. Records technician observation, not Graph verification.

details: Inspect the checklist application baseline on the computer and confirm the required applications and outcomes.
Missing or failed applications must not be marked complete merely because a sync request succeeded.
steps.summary: Follow checklist steps 18-19: verify every required application and install one at a time in order.
steps.notes: Leave incomplete while any required installation is failing. Step M can request sync for a failure, not the named portal remediation, or record no failures after this baseline is confirmed. Confirmation defaults to Y.

details: Choose no failures or request a sync for failed applications. Enter defaults to no failures, which requires the application baseline to be confirmed first.
Sync is not the named portal application-remediation action and does not prove installation success. An accepted sync must not be automatically replayed.
steps.displayName: Review application failures and sync if needed
steps.summary: Record no failures after baseline confirmation, or request sync for a failed application and record its outcome.
steps.notes: No failures is the default and sends no sync; it requires the confirmed baseline. On the failure path, sync is automated and the retry outcome is separately confirmed by the technician. Neither path invokes the named portal remediation.

details: Install the required manufacturer and other updates, complete the remaining local procedures, and shut down the computer as required by the checklist.
Confirm only after observing the required outcomes. The script does not remotely certify patch currency or power state.
steps.displayName: Confirm updates, required procedures and shutdown
steps.summary: Follow checklist steps 20-22: complete manufacturer updates, reboots and required procedures, then power off.
steps.notes: Use approved manufacturer procedures for non-Dell devices. Confirmation defaults to Y.

details: Explicitly select and confirm the eligible active C/E final user, then assign and verify the intended primary-user relationships.
Complete the external checklist handoffs separately. Neither account selection nor an administrative completion override proves a successful physical build.
steps.summary: Explicitly select an eligible active C/E account and assign it across the available Autopilot and managed-device user-assignment surfaces.
steps.notes: Selection is filtered to active C/E accounts only; contractors and non-managers remain eligible. No manager-chain or role inference is performed. Both assignment surfaces use the shared guarded REST transport. Managed-device reference-write support remains a tenant acceptance gate; submission alone is not verification.
